Workshop disposition: unresolved

The Council voted first on S/2024/323, the Chinese and Russian amendment to S/2024/302. Japan opposed it and China supported it. It received 7 votes for, 7 against and 1 abstention and failed to reach the required affirmative votes. The Council then voted on S/2024/302, the Japan–US draft. Japan supported it, China abstained and Russia cast the sole negative vote. The draft had 13 votes for, 1 against and 1 abstention. It was not adopted due to the negative vote of a permanent member.
